actions.description: Dump current records and check persistence
actions.command:
/nix/store/3n4qphl9s728sz8frmpqqrv9b1m87g68-python3-3.14.7/bin/python -c "
import sqlite3
db=sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3')
for row in db.execute('SELECT id,value FROM records ORDER BY id'): print(row)
print('journal:', db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode').fetchone())
"; ls -la /var/lib/failover/; findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE /var/lib 2>/dev/null || echo "/var/lib on root fs"
